questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The number of four-letter words that can be formed with letters <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>c</mi></math> such that all three letters occur is
questions.solution:
Out of given three letters a, b, c, we will repeat exactly one of the letter and we can do this in C13 ways. 

Now, we have four letters and out of these four letters two are identical, so number of ways to arrange these four letters is 4!2!.

So, the number of four letter words that can be formed with letters a, b, c such that all three letters occur is C13×4!2!=36
